d: A man, who blames Jonathan for his sister's death, plants chemicals in the Harts' pool to blind him.
Max is kidnapped to force the Harts to throw a race in which their thoroughbred is running.
Jonathan and Jennifer become targets for murder when they stumble on the wreckage of a sunken yacht.

Michael is pressured into betraying Florida's strongest convictions when he becomes a member of a street gang that is terrorizing the neighborhood. Fearing for her son and fighting mad, Florida confronts "The Warlords" in their secret stronghold.

When Michael experiences the pains of his first great romance, J.J.'s brotherly advice gets him the pains of a punch in the mouth. The desperate Michael needs some help to win over his new girlfriend, but when big brother J.J. turns on his charm, the happy pair becomes a battling triangle.

J.J. becomes an instant celebrity after winning a local art show, but fame proves to be expensive, when shady politico Alderman Davis wants J.J. to campaign for him J.J. has no choice but to follow Alderman Davis' wishes, at least for the time being...

Folks say there are only three ways out of the ghetto -- education, entertainment or crime. When J.J. loses his job, he must pick one of these, and everyone knows he's not a scholar (the first of a two-part episode).
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal and decides to auction it.
Fred's 65th birthday disappoints when the celebration doesn't meet his expectations.
Lamont is left standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.
